expected_behavior: A pure sub-lift / partial cancellation notice on an ongoing fixture with no new charter-party clauses must be classified as CLIENT_REPLY with urgency high (sub-lift rule), NOT FIXTURE_RECAP.

input.subject: RE: MV STELLA / our acct - subs lifted
input.body:
Dear Mehmet,

Reverting on MV STELLA / wheat Constanta-Alexandria.

We are pleased to confirm our charterers have LIFTED ALL SUBJECTS on the fixture this morning. All terms exactly as per our recap of 26 May — no changes, nothing further to add.

However please note one of the two part-cargoes has been SUB-LIFTED short: charterers can only stem abt 8,000 mt of the second parcel instead of 12,000 mt, balance cancelled. Kindly advise owners ASAP so they can refix the freed space; this affects the stem and we need owners' acknowledgement today.

Pls revert most urgently.

Best regards,
Layla Haddad
Levant Grain Trading S.A.L.
